spec.query:
SELECT min("Lap_Time") FROM "default"."simulated_can_frame"
WHERE "Lap_Time" > 1 AND time > now() - 3h
SELECT "Lap_Time" FROM "simulated_can_frame" WHERE time > now() - 6h ORDER BY time DESC

SELECT mean("Lap_Distance")
FROM "simulated_can_frame"
WHERE $timeFilter
GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT max("G_Force_Lat") AS "Latitude", max("G_Force_Long") AS "Longitude", max("G_Force_Vert") -1 AS "Verical" FROM "simulated_can_frame" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
